parameters.query:
-- Steps 2-4 of the spec are most of the workflow: sending the message is
-- the easy part, not sending it at the wrong moment is the work.
--
-- open_calls:      is this contact already in an open conversation? Two bots
--                  texting one person is worse than not texting them at all.
-- inbound_today:   proxy for the per-contact per-day rescue rate limit, and
--                  the only counter that exists until the messaging transport
--                  lands.
-- timezone:        the location's own clock decides quiet hours, not the
--                  workflow server's.
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM calls c
    WHERE c.from_phone = $1 AND c.ended_at IS NULL)                          AS open_calls,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM calls c
    WHERE c.from_phone = $1
      AND c.started_at::date = (now() AT TIME ZONE COALESCE(l.timezone, $2))::date)
                                                                             AS inbound_today,
  COALESCE(l.timezone, $2)                                                   AS timezone,
  COALESCE(l.business_name, '')                                             AS business_name,
  COALESCE(l.business_hours::text, '{}')                                    AS business_hours
FROM (SELECT 1) x
LEFT JOIN locations l ON l.active AND l.location_id = $3;
